verdict.rationale: Browserbase provides full headless browser control (auto-waits, network interception, multi-tab) and can convert any URL into HTML/JSON/markdown, which directly supports rendering JS-heavy SPAs and extracting fully rendered HTML. However, missing for 10: no explicit first-party benchmark or independent hands-on test confirming SPA rendering fidelity, and no detailed docs on handling specific JS frameworks or infinite-scroll/dynamic content edge cases.
